fields.statement: At 73d2ed3f built rhiza (go build -trimpath) and ran its real daemon (paused, rhiza.web.port 18779) in a scratch clone holding copies of this repo's 101 run journals and 93 driver logs. GET /runs/<id> answered 200 for a ship-change run with a review step, a plan run and a succeeded ship-change run, and 404 for an unknown run. The ship-change page shows its steps in order (build/build, build/render, build/check, review/code, review/review) with done pills, durations, times and details (3 of 3 leaves passed, exit 0), each step's sessions (Session 1 finished · 1141274 tokens, matching input+output+cache_creation+cache_read from /api/run.status), and a Review section per check (compliance passed, quality open, qa open, scope passed) with each finding's severity, reason, place and confirmed verdict; no node, run or finding ID in the visible text. The plan run shows interview through close-out in order. The detail section declares data-rz-events=run and /fragments/run-detail?run=<id> (200); appending a line to the run's journal emitted event: run with its id on /events.

At 73d2ed3f with the same built daemon web UI: /runs/<plan run> (200) shows a Log section with the driver log's last lines in the rz-term block (log · tail, live dot) wired to /fragments/run-log?run=<id> and data-rz-events=log; appending two lines to that run's driver log emitted event: log with the run's id on /events and the fragment then ended with both new lines; /runs/<run without a log> shows No log / Only a run the daemon started headless has a driver log.

At 73d2ed3f with the same built daemon web UI over 101 copied run journals: GET /runs answered 200 and /api/run.ls listed the runs; the cycle-2 fixes touched run.status and the run page only, and the list still serves.
